about: The white hart's walk: four poses of the body's own Walk (a calm four-beat pace keyed on the leg targets: hind left, fore left, hind right, fore right; three hooves on the ground in every pose, a low swing, the body level with no bob and the head carried low), side-on, down and up, judged at the kernel's walk of 190 ms a tile (`walk_step_ms`; WANDER walks at it, HUNTING.md section 2). The foot-slide limit is the wolf's 2 px for a quadruped's four-pose loop (DECISIONS 2026-10-29).
